questions.question: Japan’s second highest national award called ‘The Order of the Rising Sun, Gold and Silver Star’ was conferred on _______ in 2019.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e.__ Shyam Saran__**

 
• **Former foreign secretary Shyam Saran** was conferred with** Japan's second-highest national award** called **‘The Order of the Rising Sun, Gold and Silver Star’** for his contributions to strengthening the strategic ties and enhancing mutual understanding between India and Japan.
 
• During his tenure, the then Japanese Prime Minister **Junichiro Koizumi** **visited India** for the** first time** in 5 years.
 
• **"India Festival" **was held in **Japan in 1988 **when he was **Deputy Chief of Mission of Embassy** of India in Japan.
 
• **'The Order of the Rising Sun'** is a Japanese government honor established in **1875 by Emperor Meiji.**

questions.question: Jhijhia dance originated in the Indian state of _________.

questions.question: In computing, ________ is a network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined security rules.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __Firewall.__**

 
• A firewall is a type of **computer-security system**.
 
• A firewall controls the flow of data from one computer or network to another and they are mainly intended to protect an individual computer system or a network from being accessed by an intruder, especially via the Internet.

**Note:**

 
• **Cookies** are small files that are stored on a user's computer. They are designed to hold a modest amount of data specific to a particular client and website and can be accessed either by the web server or the client computer. 
 
• **Spam** is an **undesired or illegal email **message.
 
• **Spyware **is unwanted software that infiltrates your computing device, stealing your internet usage data and sensitive information.

questions.question: Which of the following Indian rulers was defeated by Mahmud Ghazni in his first attack in the year 1001 AD?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __Jaipal.__**

 
• Mahmud Ghazni's chief antagonist in northern India was **Jaipal, the ruler of Punjab of the Hindushahi dynasty**.
 
• When, **in 1001 AD**, Maḥmūd marched on India at the head of 15,000 horse troops, Jaipal met him with 12,000 horse troops, 30,000-foot soldiers, and 300 elephants.
 
• In a battle near **Peshawar** (now in Pakistan) the Indians, though superior in numbers and equipment, fell back under the onslaught of the Muslim horsemen, leaving behind 15,000 dead.
 
• After falling into the hands of the victors the king Jaipal along with 15 of his relatives and officers, was finally released.
 
• He could not bear his defeat and mounted his own funeral pyre and perished in the flames.

questions.question: In which year the administration of India was transferred into the hands of the British Monarch by the Proclamation of Queen Victoria?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. __1858.__**

 
• On August 2, 1858, less than a month after Canning proclaimed the victory of British arms, Parliament passed the Government of India Act, transferring** British power over India from the East India Company to the crown. **
 
• The merchant company’s residual powers were vested in the **secretary of state for India**, a minister of Great Britain’s cabinet, who would preside over the India Office in London and be assisted and advised by a Council of India, wh
ich consisted initially of 15 Britons, 7 of whom were elected from among the old company’s court of directors and 8 of whom were appointed by the crown.
 
• The post of the **viceroy of India** was created. First such viceroy of India was **Lord Canning.**
 
• **The first **secretary of state for India was **Lord Stanley.**

questions.question: The thin layer of living cells just inside the bark of a tree is called ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 1) i.e.__ Cambium.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A thin film or skin of cells just under the bark is called the** cambium.__**
 
• Only **1 percent of a dormant mature tree is biologically living **while the rest is composed of non-living, structural wood cells.
 
• Rather, the major living and growing portions of a tree are leaves, buds, roots, and the cambium.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Xylem** is a plant vascular tissue that conveys **water and dissolved minerals** from the roots to the rest of the plant and also provides physical support. 
 
• ** Pith** is the tissue that is located in a plant’s stem and roots. It is **soft **and **spongy.** It functions by** transporting nutrients** throughout the plant and **storing nutrients** within its cells.
 
• The Crown is the **top part of the tree** from which branches grow above the stem.

questions.question: The _______ shows all the combinations of two commodities that a consumer can afford at given market prices and within the particular income level.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. __Budget Line__**

 
• The** budget line** shows all those combinations of two commodities that the consumer can buy spending his given money income on the two goods at their given prices.
 
• An** example **to understand this concept - Suppose our consumer has got an income of Rs. 100 to spend on goods A and B. Let the price of the good A in the market be Rs. 20 per unit and that of B be Rs. 10 per unit. If the consumer spends his whole income of Rs. 100 on good A, he would buy 5 units of A; if he spends his whole income of Rs. 100 on good B he would buy 10 units of B. If a straight line joining 5A and 10B is drawn, we will get what is called the **price line or the budget line.**

**​Note: **

 
• **The utility **is a term in economics that refers to the total satisfaction received from consuming a good or service.
 
• **Supply curve** in economics is a graphic representation of the relationship between product price and quantity of product that a seller is willing and able to supply.
 
• The **demand curve** in economics is a graphic representation of the relationship between product price and the quantity of the product demanded.

questions.question: What is the solid crust or the hard top layer of the earth called?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. __Lithosphere.__**

__
 
• **The lithosphere__** is a rigid, rocky outer layer of the Earth, consisting of the crust and the solid outermost layer of the upper mantle. 
 
• It extends to a **depth **of about **100 km**. 
 
• It comprises the **rocks **of the earth’s crust and **the thin layers of soil **that contain nutrient elements that sustain organisms.
 
• There are two main divisions of the earth’s surface.
 
• The large landmasses are known as the **continents** and the huge water bodies are called the **ocean basins.**

questions.question: The SI unit of radioactivity is ____________.
questions.solution:
__**CONCEPT**__:

__
 
• **Radioactivity: **Radioactive decay is the process by which an unstable atomic nucleus loses energy by radiation. A material containing unstable nuclei is considered radioactive.
 
• A **radioactive nucleus consists of an unstable assembly of protons and neutrons** which becomes more stable by emitting an alpha, a beta particle, or a gamma photon.
 
• Atoms are radioactive if their nuclei are unstable and spontaneously (and random) emit various particles α, β, and/or γ radiations.
 
• The original unit for measuring the amount of **radioactivity is Curie (Ci) **– first defined to correspond to one gram of radium-226.
 
• 1 curie = 3.7x10¹⁰ radioactive decays per second.
 
• In the International System of Units (SI)** curie has been replaced by becquerel (Bq).**
 
• **1 becquerel = 1 radioactive decay per second = 2.703x10-11 Ci.​**

**​EXPLANATION__:**

 
• **From the above discussion, the SI unit of radioactivity is Becquerel (Bq).**
 
• The correct answer is **option 4.**

questions.question: In 2019, the Indian Space Research Organisation’s (ISRO) new commercial arm called NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) was officially inaugurated in the city of ________.

The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. Bengaluru.**

questions.question: Tears in the eyes are produced by which of the following glands?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2) i.e. Lacrimal gland.**

 
• Tear duct and glands, also called** lachrymal, or lacrimal, duct and glands,** are structures that produce and distribute the watery component of the tear film.
 
• Tears consist of a complex and usually clear fluid that is diffused between the eye and the eyelid.
 
• The** mucous layer **helps the tear film **adhere to the eye surface**, while the **lipid layer **serves to **reduce tear evaporation.**
 
• **Diseases **that damage the lacrimal gland, and thus** decrease tear secretion**, can lead to chronic dry eye, which ultimately can threaten vision.

questions.question: The ________ is the longest river in Sri Lanka.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. Mahaweli.**

 
• Mahaweli Ganga river, **(Sinhalese: “Great Sandy River”)**
 
• At 335 km in length, it is **Sri Lanka’s longest river. **
 
• It rises on the Hatton Plateau on the western side of the island’s hill country, flows north through a tea and rubber growing region, and turns east near Kandy.
 
• It then turns north across the lowlands, where it meets its principal tributary, the Amban Ganga.

questions.question: As of April 2019, who is the Chairman of the joint working group of IRDA and NHA, formed to curb fraud in the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 2) i.e.__ Dinesh Arora.__**

 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** and **the National Health Authority (NHA) **have formed a working group on the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY).
 
• The joint working group, to be chaired by** Dinesh Arora, Deputy CEO of NHA,** will have **10 members** **from both the organizations.**
 
• In six months, it will submit a report on how to detect and deter fraud through a common repository and capacity-building.
